13-7.solution: The sum is the present value of three payments of Rs. \(4000\): \(4000\left(\frac{1}{1.12} + \frac{1}{1.12^2} + \frac{1}{1.12^3}\right) = 4000 \times 2.40183 \approx 9607\).

13-11.solution: At \(20\%\) a year the half-yearly rate is \(10\%\). The instalment plan is worth \(25000 + \frac{28000}{1.1} + \frac{28000}{1.21} \approx 73595.04\) today, against Rs. \(75300\) cash. Paying by instalments is cheaper by about Rs. \(1705\).

13-18.solution: Each instalment is \(\frac{6000}{\frac{1}{1.2} + \frac{1}{1.44} + \frac{1}{1.728}} = \frac{6000}{2.10648} \approx 2848.35\). Three of them total \(8545.05\), so the interest is about Rs. \(2545\).

13-23.solution: Each instalment \(x\) satisfies \(\frac{x}{1.125} + \frac{x}{1.125^2} = 7260\). The bracket is \(\frac{8}{9} + \frac{64}{81} = \frac{136}{81}\), so \(x = 7260 \times \frac{81}{136} \approx 4324\).

13-31.solution: Each instalment \(x\) satisfies \(\frac{x}{1.1} + \frac{x}{1.21} = 12100\), so \(x = \frac{12100 \times 1.21}{2.1} \approx 6971.90\). Two instalments total \(13943.81\), so the interest is about Rs. \(1844\).

13-37.solution: Each instalment is \(\frac{28000}{\frac{1}{1.15} + \frac{1}{1.15^2} + \frac{1}{1.15^3} + \frac{1}{1.15^4}} = \frac{28000}{2.85498} \approx 9807.43\). Four of them total \(39229.72\), so the difference is about Rs. \(11230\).
